title: Benchmarking uncertainty quantification for engineering regression under graded distribution shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.35356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most. Existing comparisons of regression UQ methods rely on random splits, which assess calibration only in distribution. We introduce a three-rung shift ladder (in distribution, soft shift and hard shift) built along physically meaningful shift variables, and evaluate 12 methods from five families on seven public engineering datasets: five extrapolation settings, an unseen turbofan fault mode and a winter air-quality sensor deployment. All tuning uses source data only. In distribution, conformal methods cover at least 0.946 of test points on every dataset. Under hard shift, mean coverage falls to 0.40-0.75 across the 11 methods that always return an interval, and no systematic difference in method ranks is detected (Friedman p = 0.63). Weighted conformalised quantile regression stays near nominal

translated_title: 基于分级分布偏移的工程回归不确定性量化基准测试
translated_abstract: 工程中的机器学习模型常常在超出其训练条件的情况下使用，此时可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）最为关键。现有的回归UQ方法比较依赖于随机数据划分，只能评估分布内的校准性能。我们引入了一个基于具有物理意义的偏移变量构建的三级“偏移阶梯”（分布内、软偏移和硬偏移），并在七个公开工程数据集上评估了来自五个方法家族的12种方法：五个外推设置、一种未见过的涡扇发动机故障模式以及一次冬季空气质量传感器部署。所有调优仅使用源数据。在分布内情形下，共形方法在每个数据集上至少覆盖了0.946的测试点。在硬偏移下，11种总是返回预测区间的方法平均覆盖率降至0.40–0.75，且未检测到方法排名存在系统性差异（Friedman p = 0.63）。加权共形化分位数回归则保持接近名义覆盖率水平……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于物理意义偏移变量构建的三级分布偏移评估阶梯，在七个公开工程数据集上系统基准测试了12种不确定性量化方法，发现分布内共形方法校准良好，但在硬偏移下所有方法覆盖率均大幅下降且方法间无系统性优劣差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a three-rung distribution shift ladder built on physically meaningful shift variables and benchmarks 12 uncertainty quantification methods on seven public engineering datasets, showing that conformal methods are well calibrated in distribution while under hard shift all methods' coverage drops substantially with no systematic difference in method ranking.
